en.title: Bill dispute ends fatally: Customer attacks kebab vendor with sidewalk stone
en.summary: A 46-year-old kebab vendor in Ankara was attacked with a sidewalk stone by a customer during an argument over a bill.

en.summary: A detention order was issued against Ali Tarakçı, who posted on social media that an important minister would resign on Friday.

en.title: After saying 'a minister will resign': Investigation launched against journalist Ali Tarakçı
en.summary: Journalist Ali Tarakçı faces investigation for spreading misleading information after posting that an important minister would resign. A detention order was issued and his residence was to be searched.

en.title: Bill dispute proves fatal: Kebab vendor loses three-day fight for life
en.summary: A 46-year-old kebab vendor in Ankara died in hospital after being severely injured by a customer's sidewalk stone attack during a payment dispute.

stories.title: Havada arızalanan eğitim uçağı tarlaya zorunlu iniş yaptı

en.title: Training aircraft with engine failure makes emergency landing in field
en.summary: A training aircraft that departed from Istanbul experienced engine trouble and was forced to land in a field in Tekirdağ's Süleymanpaşa district.

en.title: Breaking: 4 arrested, 2 under judicial control in fund investigation
en.summary: Six individuals referred to court in a fund investigation resulted in four arrests and two being released under judicial supervision.

en.title: Second suicide in Ankara same day: Newly appointed police officer ends his life
en.summary: A police officer with only two months of service took his own life at his residence in Ankara's Yenimahalle district.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 13 şüpheliye adli kontrol

en.title: New development in fund investigation: 13 suspects released on judicial control
en.summary: Thirteen suspects detained in a stock market manipulation investigation were released under judicial supervision, though prosecutors indicated they would appeal the decision.

stories.title: Tanju Özcan'ın yargılandığı davada mütaala açıklandı! İşte istenen cezalar

en.title: Prosecutor's opinion announced in trial of Tanju Özcan! Here are the requested sentences
en.summary: A prosecutor submitted their opinion in a corruption case involving 19 defendants including suspended Bolu Mayor Tanju Özcan. The opinion specified requested sentences against the detained defendant Özcan.

stories.title: Ankara’da aynı gün ikinci intihar… Polis memuru yaşamına son verdi

en.title: Second suicide in Ankara on the same day... Police officer ends his life
en.summary: A two-month police officer employed at a mobile police unit in Ankara's Yenimahalle district died by suicide at his residence. The officer reportedly left a letter for his family before the incident.

stories.title: "İrtikap" davasında Tanju Özcan için istenen ceza belli oldu

en.title: Requested sentence for Tanju Özcan determined in "embezzlement" case
en.summary: In a trial involving 19 defendants including suspended Bolu Mayor Tanju Özcan in an embezzlement investigation, prosecutors submitted their opinion. The prosecutor requested a combined sentence of 217 years against Özcan for multiple charges including qualified fraud and bribery.

stories.title: Tanju Özcan için istenen ceza belli oldu

en.title: Requested sentence for Tanju Özcan determined
en.summary: The prosecutor in the Bolu Municipality case specified requested sentences for suspended Mayor Tanju Özcan ranging between 69.5 and 217 years.

stories.title: Putin'den Ukrayna mesajı: Müzakereleri Rusya'nın çıkarları doğrultusunda başlatacağız

en.title: Putin's message on Ukraine: We will initiate negotiations in line with Russia's interests
en.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that decisions regarding resuming negotiations with Ukraine will be made according to Russia's interests. He also indicated Russia has no plans for conflict with Europe and welcomed discussions between the United States and China.

stories.title: Turgutlu'da 11 öğrencinin yaralandığı olayda 7 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: 7 suspects arrested in incident where 11 students were injured in Turgutlu
en.summary: Seven of ten suspects brought to court in connection with an incident in Turgutlu where eleven students were injured have been arrested. Three other suspects were released under judicial supervision.

en.title: New York stock exchange closes with gains
en.summary: The New York stock exchange ended the week's final trading session higher. The Dow Jones index gained over 470 points, rising 0.93 percent to close at 51,828.62.

stories.title: 4.7 trilyon dolarlık kâr havuzu yer değiştiriyor

en.title: 4.7 trillion dollar profit pool is shifting
en.summary: As profit pools shift, competitive differentiation will depend on rapidly and rigorously reinventing business models rather than adopting specific artificial intelligence solutions. Success requires identifying which profit pools become indefensible rather than simply deploying AI models.

stories.title: Yapay zekâ çağının yeni maliyet kalemi: Token

en.title: Artificial intelligence era's new cost factor: Token
en.summary: Artificial intelligence is creating a new expense category for companies, with usage-based token billing replacing traditional fixed software licenses. Despite falling token prices, rising usage keeps overall costs from declining, while developing nations like Turkey face additional challenges from currency risk and opportunity costs.
